title: Serving Ops — Anchor Agenda & Action Tracker
content:
Purpose: quick, focused weekly with the runtime/infra/console anchors. Keep it <=30m, surface risks, confirm next-step owners.

Timebox & attendees:
- 25–30m total
- Sophie (facilitator), Ravi (infra), Ivy (console), Marco (serving runtime), optional: ops-oncall (rotate)

Top goals this week:
1) Validate canary fallback path after quantized rollout (low-latency fallback working?)
2) Confirm KV-cache eviction telemetry and ops alert threshold tuning
3) Console UX: token/route cost breakdown glitch repro + quick mitigation plan
4) Sprint housekeeping: who owns the autoscale burn-down

Agenda (rough order):
- 3m: quick wins / blockers (round-robin; note any urgent pages)
- 8m: Canary incident follow-up (Marco) — what we saw, tentative root cause, temp mitigations
- 6m: KV cache telemetry (Ravi) — new metrics, alert gaps, suggested thresholds
- 6m: Console bug triage (Ivy) — repro steps, scope, hotfix vs next sprint
- 2m: action review + owners + due dates

Notes to self / prompts to ask during meeting:
- When Marco walks through the canary logs ask for exact trace ids + which kernel version used.
- For cache telemetry: ask if we can expose prefix-hit ratio per model family in the next 2 sprints.
- Console: verify whether the cost breakdown regressions only happen on model variants with batching enabled.

Open questions we should resolve in 1:1s if not in sync:
- Is the autoscaler reacting to the right p95 or p99 signal? (talk to Ravi offline)
- Do we have a short-term fallback policy that routes to cheaper region without degrading SLA? (Marco to confirm)

Action items (live tracker):
- A1: Marco — produce a short incident appendix w/ traces + kernel version + suspected patch by Thu 2026-03-13. (owner: Marco Li; due: 2026-03-13)
- A2: Ravi — add prefix-hit metric to infra-metrics dashboard; propose alert thresholds and add runbook snippet by Mon 2026-03-16. (owner: Ravi Patel; due: 2026-03-16)
- A3: Ivy — create a minimal repro deck and propose console roll-forward/hotfix plan; include affected routes list by Tue 2026-03-17. (owner: Ivy Gonzalez; due: 2026-03-17)
- A4: Sophie — coordinate post-mortem invite and rough timeline; draft canary rollback checklist and share with execs by Fri 2026-03-14. (owner: Sophie Kim; due: 2026-03-14)
- A5: Marco & Ravi — validate autoscaler p99 signal alignment and report options (p95 vs p99) by next sync. (owner: Marco Li, Ravi Patel; due: 2026-03-18)

Parking lot (not today):
- Quantized model perf regression triage (schedule separate deep-dive)
- Long-term: cost-aware routing policy RFC (put on product backlog)

Micro-routines for meeting flow (notes to self):
- Start on time, call out timebox at 18m mark for decisions, and move unresolved items to follow-ups.
- Keep action item line: owner, deliverable, due date — repeat at close.

Quick log of pre-meeting checks (Sophie):
- Confirmed oncall rotation + Slack bridge set (yes)
- Linked the new infra dashboard to meeting thread (yes)
- Reviewed last week's actions: A-priorities closed: 3/5, open: A5 (autoscale)

End-state: leave meeting with owners and dates for all open items; escalate any SLA risks immediately.

(Notes-to-self: this doc is ephemeral — snapshot into team thread, then migrate the action list to Jira INF-1428 as sub-tasks.)
